sentences.en: He makes it a rule to read aloud every day.
sentences.zh: 他规定自己每天都要大声读书。

sentences.en: Please read it aloud so that everyone can hear.
sentences.zh: 请大声朗读，以便每个人都能听到。

sentences.en: He thought to himself, "No!" Aloud he said, "Yes."
sentences.zh: 他在心里想：‘不！’但他出声说的是：‘是的。’

senses.zh: 出声地大声地, 高声地
